question: Which elements show similar valency as that of silicon?
solution:
The correct answer is __**C and Ge**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Each of the following elements has **four valence electrons**: **germanium, silicon, and carbon**.
 
• The production of **semiconductor **devices uses the rare **element germanium**. Germanium shares a lot of **similarities with silicon** in terms of its **physical and chemical** characteristics.
 
• Coal, ore, and **germanite **all contain semi-metal **germanium**. Germanium is a **gray-white metal** that **crystallizes.**
 
• **Group 14 **is where both **carbon and silicon** belong. As a result, both elements have a** valence electron** with a value **of four.**
 
• The nearest **substitute for carbon is silicon**. Tetravalent elements like **carbon and silicon** both create mostly **covalent non-ionic** molecules.
 
• *Therefore, elements that show similar valency as that of silicon are C and Ge.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chemically speaking,** silicon** is an element with the **symbol Si** and **atomic number 14.**
 
• It is a **tetravalent metalloid and semiconductor** that has a blue-gray metallic sheen and is a tough, **brittle crystalline solid.**
 
• With **carbon above it** and **germanium, tin,** lead, and flerovium **below it** on the periodic table, it belongs to **group 14.**
 
• The element is a crucial **component of bricks and ceramics**. Since it is a semiconductor, the element is used to** create transistors.**
